 Muthu Muthiah - Inefficiency and Innovation at CHOA (EP. 339) 
 
 Muthu Muthiah - Inefficiency and Innovation at CHOA (EP. 339) Sep 18, 2023

 Muthu Muthiah is the Chief Investment Officer
of Children’s Healthcare of Atlanta (CHOA), one of the largest
pediatric clinical care providers in the U.S. Muthu stewards CHOA’s
$6 billion long term pool of capital, arriving a year ago after
stints across a range of allocator seats the past twenty years.

  

 Our conversation covers Muthu’s mobile
upbringing, path to finance, and lessons learned working for a
range of asset owners. We discuss his first CIO seat at Inatai,
where he oversaw a $2 billion portfolio starting with a clean sheet
of paper, and his new seat at CHOA, including the portfolio
framework, team structure, and aspiration to achieve concentration,
search for inefficiency, and invest in innovation.

here.

 About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
